summary: Tested Work Hub structured clinical follow-up on the backend and frontend (PREVIEW). Backend: 20/20 pytest pass covering meta/catalog (12 categories, RESULTS excluded, catalog keys, priorities order), IMAGING auto message (deterministic, 'MRI · Liver', labels, message_auto), BLOODWORK order preserved, REFERRAL DECLINED->referral_subtype, ASAP CALL_TRANSFER with empty message, OTHER free text, 8 validation 400 cases, staff B1 403, staff Attention/Requested action unchanged, legacy MESSAGE path, and legacy RESULTS still listed. Frontend: every requested flow passed for physician and staff (optgroups, IMAGING/BLOODWORK detail selectors, aria-pressed chips, optional-message label, submit with empty message, card summary/reason/clinic-action chips, detail panel + history event, priority order Normal/B2/B1/ASAP, MESSAGE has no structured block and needs a message, staff has no priority control and shows attention/requested-action only when sending to the physician, referral reasons and clinic action). Legacy RESULTS cards (WRK-000068/69) still show 'Results / Imaging / BW' unchanged. Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow. One responsive bug: the dialog has no scroll, so it overflows on shorter phones.

minor.issue: There is one shared clinical_detail.other_text for all detail fields. For IMAGING with modality=OTHER and body_site=OTHER, detail_summary uses other_text for both fields and gives 'X · X'.

Staff can also send a clinical type with only a reason and an empty message, which creates an auto message. The spec describes this as physician-only. This may be intended (the frontend allows it too), but please confirm.

The auto message for CALL_BOOK_PATIENT + reason CALL_TRANSFER_ON_ARRIVAL + ASAP is 'Call / Book Patient — Call patient — put through to me when I arrive. Book patient as soon as possible.' The two instructions conflict (transfer vs book ASAP).

ui_bugs.issue: The dialog has no max-height or overflow-y, and it is a fixed, centred grid. At 390x667 with IMAGING + modality OTHER (Specify field visible), the dialog is about 814px tall: top=-59px, bottom=740px. The title, close X and the Send button are off-screen and cannot be reached by scrolling. At 390x844 it only just fits (about 780px). Fix: add className 'max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' to the DialogContent in workHubParts.jsx line 271.

issues: The detail panel on the right is not sticky. If you click a card far down a long list, the detail renders at the top of the right column, out of view, and the visible right side looks blank.

design_issues.screen: Work card for CALL_BOOK_PATIENT with reason CALL_TRANSFER_ON_ARRIVAL
issues: The reason line 'Call patient — put through to me when I arrive' and the fuchsia chip 'Put through to me on arrival' repeat the same information.

action_items: Make NewWorkDialog scrollable on short viewports (max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto on DialogContent).
Optional: separate other_text per detail field (or one 'Other' per field) to avoid 'X · X' summaries.
Optional: decide whether a clinic-staff auto message (no written message) is allowed for clinical types.
Optional: make the WorkHub detail column sticky (md:sticky md:top-4) for long lists.
critical_code_review_comments: work_hub_catalog.validate_structured is solid: codes are validated against the catalog, labels are snapshotted, single vs multi is enforced, and there are no mongo _id leaks (confirmed through GET).
The frontend gets every option list from /meta catalog, so nothing is duplicated in React. Good.
ReasonLine hides the reason when reason_code === referral_subtype, which works as intended for referral badges.
The backend err log has an old 'CreateBody object has no attribute attention_level' traceback from before the last reload (before 05:17). It did not happen again during testing.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; one responsive overflow bug on short phones)
